notices.title: COLLECTING SIESTA OBSIDIAN TO REDEEM LIMITED REWARDS
lines: DETAILS: During the event, players can collect Siesta Obsidian to complete the Milestone Missions. When Siesta Obsidian reaches a certain number, players can obtain corresponding rewards.

props.rewardNote: First-clear rewards are once per account: a stage cleared in the original run gives none in the rerun.
